finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer can get a full refund only within the plan's window and only if usage stays under 10,000 tokens.

finePrint.summary: After the refund window, the purchase is final with no cancellation or refund of the subscription fee.

quote.text: AFTER THAT, YOUR PURCHASE IS FINAL, AND YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO CANCEL THE PURCHASE AND/OR RECEIVE A REFUND OF YOUR SUBSCRIPTION FEE AT ANY TIME.

trials.claim: Previous customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased WordHero can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm purchasing two or multiple AppSumo codes to obtain additional functionality, with no exhibit undercutting code stacking.

exhibits.quote: I bought two codes to obtain the long-form editor.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms purchasing two codes to obtain additional functionality.

exhibits.quote: I had purchased multiple codes via APPSUMO and there was an issue with redemption.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms previous customers could purchase multiple codes.

trials.claim: Previous customers will be grandfathered into new feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.reasoning: The binding terms reserve the vendor's right to change or discontinue any part of the Services at any time without notice, materially limiting the grandfathering promise.

exhibits.quote: Because our Services are evolving over time we may change or discontinue all or any part of the Services, at any time and without notice, at our sole discretion.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to change or discontinue any part of the Services at any time, which undermines any promise of grandfathered limits.

trials.claim: Product can generate blog posts, ads, sales copy, emails and more in 1 click
trials.claimQuote: Use AI to generate original blog posts, ads, sales copy, emails, and more - in just 1 click
trials.reasoning: Buyers report needing at least three attempts for usable output and that blog writing requires an Editor mode not included, contradicting 1-click generation of blog posts and other copy.

exhibits.quote: Most of the time I have to enter in a configuration of words at least 3 times before I get something and even then it's not really on the money, it hasn't saved me any time at all.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports needing multiple attempts and still not getting usable output, contradicting 1-click generation.

exhibits.quote: This package does not come with the EDITOR mode which is a must have if you are looking to write blog content.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports blog content requires a separate Editor mode not included, contradicting 1-click blog generation.

exhibits.quote: Create ads, emails, social posts, sales copy, article briefs and drafts, featured images, and more.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states the product creates ads, emails, sales copy and more.

exhibits.quote: The variety of templates is impressive, catering to everything from blog posts to social media captions.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms templates cover blog posts and other content types.

trials.claim: Users can write faster in their own unique voice with AI help
trials.claimQuote: Write faster in your own unique voice with the help of AI
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report output identical to their input and endlessly repetitive content, undercutting the claim of faster writing in a unique voice despite one positive review.

exhibits.quote: The output was 100% word for word what I input, ZERO variation and TWO results identical.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports output identical to input with no variation, contradicting faster writing in a unique voice.

exhibits.quote: It keeps repeating over and over the same things and I've just tried to write some basic articles about easy topics such as self-help/general finance.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports repetitive output that lacks originality and depth, undermining the unique-voice claim.

exhibits.quote: Turn your next idea into content that sounds like you.
exhibits.argument: The vendor promises content that sounds like the user.

exhibits.quote: I appreciate how it understands the tone I'm aiming for and helps refine my voice without losing authenticity.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tool helps refine their voice while keeping authenticity.

trials.claim: Supports content generation in over 100 languages
trials.claimQuote: WordHero supports content generation in over 100 languages, including English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Spanish, Hindi, Arabic, Portuguese, French, Russian, German, Japanese, Italian, Swedish, Hebrew, Indonesian, Tagalog, Korean, Persian, Vietnamese, and Thai.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report Spanish generation producing absurd, cut-off, or English sentences and Dutch quality crashing, materially limiting the claimed support for over 100 languages.

exhibits.quote: When I try to use this to generate content in Spanish language, it always shows absurd sentences, cut sentences or even 1 or 2 of the generated options are shown directly in English language.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports Spanish generation produces absurd or English output, contradicting support for over 100 languages.

exhibits.quote: And when you try using another language then english ( like dutch in my case ).then the quality crashes even more.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports non-English quality crashes, undermining the multilingual generation claim.

exhibits.quote: WordHero supports writing in 108 distinct languages. The app shows 109 locale options because English is available in both US and UK variants.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states support for 108 distinct languages.

exhibits.quote: I use it for european spanish and it works fine in this language too.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tool works in a non-English language.

trials.claim: AI does not lift content from online sources, reducing plagiarism risk
trials.claimQuote: However, the AI technology used by WordHero is based on a generative language model and does not lift content from online sources, reducing the risk of plagiarism.
trials.reasoning: The terms disclaimer addresses content quality and reliability generally but says nothing about lifting content from online sources or plagiarism risk, and no defense exhibit is provided.

exhibits.quote: We make no warranty regarding the quality, accuracy, timeliness, truthfulness, completeness or reliability of any information or content on the Services.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims all warranties about content quality and reliability, undermining the claim of reduced plagiarism risk.
